title: 千禧未来主义
description: 世纪之交，人们把对“2000 年”的期待做进了电脑、手机和屏幕。一支 18 秒短片，铬、果冻、泡泡和玻璃都由着色器逐帧算出：从开机画面、Wipeout 的铬字、果冻色 iMac G3、Mac OS X 的 Aqua、i-mode 的 176 个像素表情，到千年虫倒计时，一路加载到今天的 Liquid Glass。

images.title: 一张海报，认识千禧未来主义
四种材质、铬的色标、色板、字体、界面零件与五条规则
images.titleEn: Four materials, chrome stops, palette, typography, UI parts, and five rules

images.title: 一张普通海报，四步改成 Y2K
images.titleEn: Four steps from a plain poster to Y2K

descriptionEn: At the turn of the millennium, hopes for the year 2000 were built into computers, phones, and screens. An 18-second film in which chrome, jelly, bubbles, and glass are lit frame by frame by a shader: from a boot screen, wide chrome lettering, the translucent iMac G3, Aqua, and 176 pixel emoji to the millennium bug countdown and today’s Liquid Glass.
